segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַתִּינוֹקוֹת אֵין מְעַנִּין אוֹתָן בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, אֲבָל מְחַנְּכִין אוֹתָן לִפְנֵי שָׁנָה וְלִפְנֵי שְׁנָתַיִים, בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיִּהְיוּ רְגִילִין בְּמִצְוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «the children, one does not afflict them» by withholding food «on Yom Kippur; however, one trains them one year before or two years before» they reach majority, by means of a partial fast lasting several hours, «so that they will be accustomed to» fulfill «mitzvot.»

moves.summary: children not afflicted; trained a year or two before

positions.claim: children are not afflicted but are trained one or two years before majority
